title: Fix it: send order dates in the format the partner asked for
basics: A date in text form, such as `"2024-03-05"`, becomes a real Date with `as Date`. A Date can then be written as text in any layout with `as String {format: "..."}`, where the pattern letters stand for parts of the date: `dd` is the day, `MM` the month and `yyyy` the year.
prompt:
The script in the editor is **almost** right. It passes on the sample and fails on a case you cannot see.

The original task was:

A UK partner wants every order date as day/month/year with a four-digit year, for example `05/03/2024`.

Orders arrive as `{ id, date }` with the date in ISO form (`2024-03-05`). Return `{ id, date }` with the date reformatted.

Find what is wrong and fix it. You can press Run to see what it currently does.
starter:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map { id: $.id, date: $.date as Date as String {format: "DD/MM/yyyy"} }
hints: Run it on the sample first. If the sample looks right, the bug only shows on data the sample does not contain.
Ask what kind of input would break this — an empty list, a missing field, a value ordered differently.
uses DD, the day of the year, instead of dd, the day of the month
solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map { id: $.id, date: $.date as Date as String {format: "dd/MM/yyyy"} }

mustFail.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map { id: $.id, date: $.date as Date as String {format: "DD/MM/yyyy"} }

explanation.approach: The pattern letters are case-sensitive, and two of the upper-case ones mean something else entirely. `YYYY` is the week-based year: it matches the calendar year almost all the time, so tests pass, and then prints the wrong year for the last few days of December. `DD` is the day of the year.

snippets.label: yyyy against YYYY at year end
snippets.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
[|2024-12-30| as String {format: "dd/MM/yyyy"}, |2024-12-30| as String {format: "dd/MM/YYYY"}]
snippets.note: The same date, a year apart.

snippets.label: DD is the day of the year
